items.title: Ernest "Kid" Milton Interview, 1961-04-26
items.q: Wisecaller? Yeah. Yeah. He was playing with us at that time.

ctx.x: A long time ago, the fellas would make a break on their home, like, gone around like that. You know what? It's amazing.

Now, see, if Ike was playing, I'd make him play that, not without the music, because I know it, just by the head, like, that we played it so much. And Ike, I mean, he ain't played in years, I mean, probably he wouldn't be able to make that now. But Lawrence, I mean, I'm mostly sure he would be able to make it. Wisecaller? Yeah. Yeah. He was playing with us at that time. Yeah.
And Lawrence was playing a pretty good trumpet at the time.
